title: notion-seed configuration
comment: version is deliberately NOT in a `required`: validation is per document, and only workspace.yaml holds this field — the files of databases/ do not. Requiring it in workspace.yaml is the loader's job.

parent_page_id.description: UUID of the parent page, with or without dashes. Constrained here so the config is rejected before the call: otherwise the API answers a 400 validation_error whose message is less clear, and an id shaped like a relative path would produce a URL targeting another endpoint.

acknowledge_destroy.description: Resources whose destruction you have read and accept (e.g. database.tasks). Prevents nothing: the plan only notes the acknowledgement on the resource's line.

acknowledge_data_loss.description: Resources whose data loss you have read and accept (e.g. database.tasks). Allows nothing that was refused: the plan only notes the acknowledgement on the resource's line.

prevent_destroy.description: Deprecated: renamed acknowledge_destroy. Still read in this version only, with a warning.

allow_data_loss.description: Deprecated: renamed acknowledge_data_loss. Still read in this version only, with a warning.

allOf.comment: group exists only on status, and is required there. Required because notion-seed substitutes no default value: a status option without a group would go into the payload without a group, and the API would put ALL the options in the first group, without an error — a write the plan would not have announced. Forbidden elsewhere, for the same reason as `format` outside number.

then.comment: options is required and non-empty on status: a status property created with an empty list gets filled by the API with its own default options, which the plan never showed — and whose later removal is classified as a silent rewrite, which acknowledge_data_loss only acknowledges, it does not undo it. select and multi_select do not have this constraint: their options can be managed by hand without risk of reassignment.

group.description: status only. The API accepts only these three groups, on creation as on update. Freely named groups are not supported.
